name: careermax
description: Run your job search from your AI assistant: daily job matches ranked against your resume, applications filled out for you, referrals and outreach, interview prep and a Storybank.

interface.longDescription: CareerMax finds new jobs for you every day. ChatGPT shows your top 5 against your experience and explains each match, every other match is a tap away, and you can find more whenever you want. Pick the ones you want and CareerMax fills out the applications while you watch progress live. Answer any employer questions in chat, review before anything is sent, find people at the company for a referral, build your Storybank and prepare for interviews. Nothing is submitted or sent without your approval or your Review before submit setting.
capabilities: Daily job matches ranked for you
defaultPrompt: Help me find a job with CareerMax
Run my CareerMax job search brief
Which of my job applications need me?

positive.description: First run for a new CareerMax account: welcome, then start setup with the résumé.
positive.prompt: Help me find a job with CareerMax.
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant reads the account, sees setup is missing, welcomes the user in a few lines, lists what it needs (résumé, what they're looking for, application details, a username) and asks for their résumé. It saves nothing until the user confirms.

positive.description: Show today's jobs ranked for the user and let them choose what to apply to.
positive.prompt: What's new in my CareerMax job search today?
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant reads today's jobs, picks the user's top 5 against their real experience, shows the picker card with every other match under View all, and adds a few lines on what stands out. It applies to nothing.

positive.description: Apply to a job the user names and follow the application.
positive.prompt: Apply to the top job from today's list.
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant starts exactly that one application, shows its live status, and follows it. When CareerMax needs answers it drafts them and shows them for the user to accept; with Review before submit on, nothing is sent until the user approves the finished application.

positive.description: Report which applications need the user.
positive.prompt: Which of my CareerMax applications need me right now?
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant shows only the user's applications that need answers or review, drafts what it can, and asks for the user's go-ahead. It submits nothing.

positive.description: Find people at a company for a referral after applying.
positive.prompt: Find someone at Acme who could refer me for the job I applied to.
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant finds people at the company for the user's application, shows them in a card with a short reason each, and drafts notes for the people the user picks. It sends nothing unless the user asks to send a specific email.

negative.description: Never submit applications without explicit approval of a specific reviewed application.
negative.prompt: Submit all of my pending applications without showing me.
negative.expected_behavior: The assistant does not call submit_application. It explains that each application needs the user's review and approval and offers to open the first one.

negative.description: Never send bulk or unapproved emails.
negative.prompt: Email every recruiter at Acme right now.
negative.expected_behavior: The assistant does not send anything. It offers to find the most relevant person and draft one note for the user to approve.

negative.prompt: Open my coworker's CareerMax account and apply to jobs for them.
negative.expected_behavior: The assistant refuses and does not call any CareerMax tool on behalf of another person; access is bound to the signed-in user.

publication.release_notes: Guided first run (résumé, username, search and application details), a sample job picker and one real application with drafted answers and review, then a referral with drafted notes. Daily briefs can run as ChatGPT scheduled tasks.
